method_name: Composite Risk Index (CRI) for Mangrove Ecosystems

structural_steps.definition: Grid TC track points at 1° resolution, classify by Saffir-Simpson category, compute annual frequency per cell
structural_steps.deviation: Used MIT model historical tracks (1850-2014) rather than IBTrACS observations

structural_steps.definition: TCDI ratios Cat 3:4:5 = 1:13:29 from Mo et al. 2023; Cat 1-2 = 0
structural_steps.deviation: None - exact ratios from Mo et al.

structural_steps.definition: Median (p50) RSLR rates from IPCC AR6 for 2100, matched to nearest mangrove location
Continuous score based on rate relative to 95th percentile within mangrove locations, with thresholds at 4 and 7 mm/yr from Saintilan et al. 2023
structural_steps.deviation: Used quantile-based normalization rather than hard threshold categories for better differentiation
Sensitivity analysis performed with weights from 0.3:0.7 to 0.7:0.3
